script_text: Pisces, this week builds toward a Full Moon in your sign — and a hidden truth surfaces. Jupiter, your traditional ruler, glows in your 6th house of work — pitch that promotion Friday. Saturday, the Sun enters Virgo and your 7th, where Mars opposes your watery Sun: partnership friction. Midweek, Venus in Cancer, your 5th house of romance, trines your Sun — a soulful spark near water. Thursday, the Sun squares Uranus in your 4th house — expect a domestic surprise. Friday's Full Moon in Pisces illuminates your 1st house, revealing which relationships truly fit. Monday the 24th is your power day because the Capricorn Moon trines Mars from your 11th to 7th houses, delivering a decisive ally. Thursday the 27th is your hardest day, when that Sun-Uranus square peaks. Channel water-sign empathy, but renegotiate pay — Saturn retrograde in your 2nd house rewards the ask. Follow for daily updates.
